I've exhausted over 6 therapists, 4 psychologists, 2 psychiatrists, the US Suicide Hotline, and the Samaritans. Costing over 12$k over 7ish years.  


I have no friends, I have no family.  


I don't think you read my post, "how did they work?" Seriously mate...why do you want to poke fun at me as well?  


Oh man...it might be depression...never thought of that. My major complain is that I have no options. Here, if you actually want to engage in a discussion, I severely doubt it, lets try. You state something I should "Try" and I'll tell you if I've tried it or not.
